topic: Mebel tarixi 1-qism: Mebel qanday paydo bo'lgan?
style: Photorealistic cinematic, vertical 9:16, warm soft light, shallow depth of field, slow smooth camera movement, rich detail, no on-screen text.

shots.prompt: Close-up of a hand giving a light push to a modern matte kitchen drawer; it glides and closes slowly and silently. As it closes, the scene seamlessly transforms: the drawer front turns into rough grey stone and the camera reveals an ancient stone shelf inside a dim prehistoric stone house lit by firelight.
shots.say: Ota-bobolarimiz shkaf o'rniga nima ishlatgan? Bu tortmaning tarixi besh ming yil oldin toshdan boshlangan.

shots.prompt: Inside a Neolithic stone house with a low roof, flat stone slab shelves (a stone dresser) and a stone box bed covered with furs, a small fire glowing in the central hearth, slow cinematic dolly forward through smoke and warm firelight.
shots.say: Birinchi tokcha va karavotlar toshdan yasalgan. Ular hali ham saqlanib qolgan.

shots.prompt: Ancient Egyptian workshop in golden sunlight: a carpenter carves a wooden chair with lion-paw legs, behind him a gilded wooden throne and a painted wooden chest; slow orbit camera around the gilded throne, dust in sunbeams.
shots.say: Misrda yog'och stul paydo bo'ldi. Lekin unda faqat podsho va boylar o'tirgan.

shots.prompt: A 19th century furniture factory with steam machines and large windows: workers bend steamed wooden rods into curved chair parts, and rows of identical bentwood chairs stand in long lines; slow camera tracking along the rows of chairs.
shots.say: Fabrikalar ochilgach, mebel boylarning hashamati bo'lmay qoldi va har bir uyga kirib keldi.

shots.prompt: A modern bright kitchen with light wood and white cabinets: a wide drawer full of plates closes softly by itself, then an upper cabinet door lifts up smoothly on a lift mechanism with one light touch; close-up of the metal hinge and drawer mechanism at the end.
shots.say: Bugun esa mebelni mexanizm boshqaradi: ovozsiz tortma, bir tegishda ochiladigan eshik.

cta.say: Uyingizda qaysi davr mebeli bor? Izohda yozing. Keyingi qismda stulning tarixi. Saqlab qo'ying!
